params.name: region
params.description: Grid region identifier (e.g., CAISO_NORTH). Obtain from /region-from-loc or /my-access.

params.name: signal_type
params.description: The emissions signal type to retrieve. Valid values: co2_moer, co2_aoer, health_damage.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the time window in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Maximum window is 32 days.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the time window in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

params.name: model
params.description: Model version date to use (e.g., 2026-03-01). Defaults to the latest available model for the region.

items.docs: Retrieve historical emissions data for a specified grid region and signal type within a time window. The maximum query window is 32 days. For longer historical datasets, use the /historical endpoint to download CSV files. Available to ANALYST and PRO subscribers; preview available for CAISO_NORTH.

params.name: start
params.description: Start date for historical data download (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: end
params.description: End date for historical data download (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.docs: Download multi-year historical emissions data as compressed CSV files. Returns a URL to download the CSV file for the specified grid region, signal type, and date range. Available to ANALYST and PRO subscribers.
